```yaml
name: Update Open WebUI

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install nox
        run: pip install nox

      - name: Clone Open WebUI (shallow, no .git)
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui.git open-webui-src
          rm -rf open-webui-src/.git

      - name: Remove leftover submodule artifacts
        run: |
          rm -f .gitmodules
          rm -rf .git/modules

      - name: Replace open-webui folder
        run: |
          rm -rf open-webui
          mv open-webui-src open-webui

      - name: Update contributor docs
        run: |
          DOCS_FILE="docs/CONTRIBUTING.md"
          if [ -f "$DOCS_FILE" ]; then
            echo -e "\n## Open-WebUI Folder" >> "$DOCS_FILE"
            echo "- The `open-webui` folder contains the synced Open WebUI source." >> "$DOCS_FILE"
          fi

      - name: Mention automated sync in README
        run: |
          README="README.md"
          if grep -q "Automated sync" "$README"; then
            echo "Automated sync already mentioned."
          else
            echo -e "\n### Automated Sync" >> "$README"
            echo "- This repository automatically syncs the Open WebUI source weekly." >> "$README"
          fi

      - name: Run lint and tests (exclude open-webui)
        run: nox -s lint tests -- --ignore=open-webui

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Automated sync of Open WebUI source"
          git push
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
